name: youtube-autocomplete-flashdata
description: Get YouTube search suggestions for a query prefix, language and region. Build keyword idea sheets from actual autocomplete phrases. Uses the paid FlashData API.

FLASHDATA_API_KEY.title: FlashData API key
FLASHDATA_API_KEY.description: FlashData API key from https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys with youtube_suggestions enabled. Data calls use paid Credits; pricing and job reads are free.
